build_game_level: build a Better Scrolly Maze game for a selected level using make_game
create_croppers: create observation croppers for player, patroller, and teaser views using make_croppers
run_player_sprite: run a PlayerSprite that moves through the maze with keyboard actions and stays put
run_patroller_sprite: run a PatrollerSprite that wanders horizontally and terminates the episode on player contact
run_cash_drape: run a CashDrape that collects coins, adds reward, and terminates when all coins are collected
